title: simulator-v3.0.0 TurnMessage
description: Public per-turn event for the simulator-v3.0.0 compatibility profile. Extra fields are tolerated, but true position, move, intent/verdict, and the per-turn commitment nonce must never appear before the post-game audit.

win_claim.description: A terminal claim made by the sender. `survival` is the only value this repository ever emits, and the only one the reference simulator knows (`peer/turn_sender.py::take_turn` builds `{"type": "survival"}` or `None`, and nothing else). `boxed_in` is accepted but never sent: it is a peer extension for the book's third capture condition -- a Thief whose every cardinal neighbour is barriered or off-board (`police_thief_p2p_Summary.md:810`, Appendix E rule 47). The book settles that condition through the Cop's `capture_claim` and the Thief's truthful `claim_response`, not through a claim of this shape, so we do not adopt it; but a peer that sends it is conceding, and refusing the value rejected the entire turn message and hung the match into a 0/0 (`C-037`).
